title: Landlines Vanished While Robocalls Nearly Doubled
hook: Home phones disappeared, but unwanted calls followed everyone onto mobile.
closing: The phone changed; the interruption survived and became harder to trust.
question: Do you answer unknown numbers?

segments.say: By 2024, 76 percent of US adults had no landline. Most households moved their calls elsewhere.
Telemarketing made up 36 percent of robocalls. The replacement phone experience became dominated by unwanted pitches.
Americans received 52.8 billion robocalls in 2024. As landlines vanished, unwanted calls nearly doubled.
